name: jakarta-3d-atlas
description: Bahasa Indonesia–English research atlas for Jakarta: 3D urban form with per-building satellite heights, OSM rail and waterways, dated satellite water and aerosols, Himawari clouds, radar and rainfall models.

scripts.test: node scripts/test-release-contract.mjs && node scripts/test-client-contract.mjs && node scripts/test-theme-contract.mjs && node scripts/test-environment-contract.mjs && node scripts/test-i18n-contract.mjs && node scripts/test-browser-forecast.mjs
scripts.bake:buildings: python3 scripts/bake-buildings.py extract && python3 scripts/bake-buildings.py heights && python3 scripts/bake-buildings.py bake
scripts.bake:osm: python3 scripts/bake-osm-layers.py rail && python3 scripts/bake-osm-layers.py waterways
